$extensions.source: BMW Group Brand Guidelines / awesome-design-md / bmwgroup.com press materials
$extensions.aesthetic: precision engineering showroom — angular, clinical, restrained

surface.$description: Pure White — primary surface, showroom-clean canvas. BMW's digital presence starts from clinical white, never cream or off-white.

surface-subtle.$description: Whisper Gray — alternate surface for section contrast, content wells, and grouped card backgrounds.

surface-dark.$description: Carbon Black — hero sections, dark mode surfaces. Near-black with no blue or warm cast, like carbon fiber.

surface-elevated.$description: White — elevated cards on subtle backgrounds. Elevation comes from shadow, not surface color shift.

surface-silver.$description: Brushed Silver — secondary panels, divider backgrounds. Cool metallic gray evoking aluminum trim.

accent.$description: BMW Blue — the singular interactive accent. Used exclusively for CTAs, active states, and progress indicators. Never decorative.

accent-hover.$description: BMW Focus Blue — darker active/hover state. Shifts deeper, not lighter, reflecting precision click feedback.

accent-muted.$description: Blue Tint — very light blue for selected states, active table rows, subtle highlights. Never used as a surface fill.

text-primary.$description: Charcoal — primary text on light surfaces. Not pure black, but close. Cool-neutral without warmth.

text-secondary.$description: Meta Gray — body copy, descriptions, secondary information. Medium-weight neutral.

text-tertiary.$description: Silver Text — captions, timestamps, disabled labels. Light enough to recede, dark enough to read.

text-on-dark.$description: White text on Carbon Black backgrounds. Full white, no reduction.

text-on-dark-secondary.$description: Silver on dark — secondary text on Carbon Black. Cool gray, no warm tint.

text-on-accent.$description: White on BMW Blue. Full contrast for CTA legibility.

error.$description: Signal Red — error states, destructive actions. Pure red with no orange warmth, like a BMW instrument cluster warning.

success.$description: Racing Green — success confirmations, positive status. Deep, desaturated green that does not compete with BMW Blue.

warning.$description: Amber — caution states, intermediate status. Instrument-cluster amber.

border.$description: Light Steel — default border, dividers, table rules. Cool neutral, never warm.

border-strong.$description: Medium Steel — emphasized borders, input outlines on focus-adjacent states.

border-on-dark.$description: Dark border — dividers on Carbon Black sections. Barely visible structural line.

font-display.$value: 'BMWTypeNext', 'BMW Type Next Latin', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
font-display.$description: Display/heading typeface — BMWTypeNext is proprietary. Light (300) weight for display sizes creates the signature airy, engineered look. Helvetica is the primary fallback, not system-ui.

font-body.$value: 'BMWTypeNext', 'BMW Type Next Latin', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
font-body.$description: Body/UI typeface — same family, Regular (400) weight. The font is geometric, wide-set, and neutral with slight humanist touches.

font-mono.$description: Monospace — for VIN numbers, technical specs, configurator codes. Never used decoratively.

scale-display.$description: Display — hero headlines. Weight 300 (Light). The light weight at large sizes is BMW's typographic signature.

scale-subheading.$description: Subheading — card titles, subsection heads. Weight 400.

scale-body-large.$description: Body Large — lead paragraphs, featured descriptions. Weight 300.

scale-caption.$description: Caption — metadata, labels, secondary info. Weight 400.

scale-small.$description: Small — legal text, fine print. Weight 400.

scale-overline.$description: Overline — category labels, eyebrow text. Weight 700, letter-spacing 1.5px, uppercase.

line-height-tight.$description: Tight — display headlines at 56px. Minimal leading for engineered precision.

line-height-normal.$description: Normal — body text. Slightly tighter than editorial brands. Efficient, not luxurious.

letter-spacing-tight.$description: Tight — display headlines. Negative tracking tightens large light-weight type.

letter-spacing-wide.$description: Wide — overline labels, category tags. Uppercase text gets expanded tracking.

weight-light.$description: Light — display headlines. The defining BMW typographic weight at large sizes.

weight-regular.$description: Regular — body text, section headings, UI elements.

weight-bold.$description: Bold — overline labels, emphasis within body, navigation active states.

unit.$description: Base grid unit — all spacing is a multiple of 8px.

2xs.$description: Micro — icon-to-label gaps, inline element spacing.

xs.$description: Extra small — tight element spacing, small padding.

sm.$description: Small — button padding (vertical), compact card gaps.

md.$description: Medium — standard card padding, input padding, grid gaps.

lg.$description: Large — section element spacing, card content padding.

section-gap.$description: Vertical gap between major page sections. Generous but disciplined.

container-max.$description: Max container width — wider than many brands, reflecting BMW's widescreen cinematic layouts.

container-content.$description: Max content width — text and form content within the wider container.

radius-none.$description: Zero radius — BMW's signature. Cards, buttons, inputs, images all use sharp 0px corners. This is the default and the rule, not the exception.

radius-minimal.$description: Minimal radius — only for small interactive elements (toggles, chips) where sharp corners feel physically uncomfortable at tiny sizes.

radius-pill.$description: Pill shape — tags and status badges only. The contrast with zero-radius rectangles makes pills read as metadata, not containers.

level-0.$description: Flat — no elevation. Default state for most elements. BMW prefers flat surfaces with border delineation.

level-1.$description: Subtle elevation — hover states on cards, dropdown menus. Barely perceptible lift, like a panel hovering 1mm above a showroom display.

level-2.$description: Modal elevation — dialogs, popovers, configurator overlays. Noticeable but controlled.

duration-instant.$description: Instant — micro-interactions (button press feedback, toggle state).

duration-fast.$description: Fast — standard hover transitions, opacity changes.

duration-normal.$description: Normal — panel slides, accordion reveals, tab transitions.

duration-slow.$description: Slow — hero image fades, page-level transitions, configurator 3D rotations.

easing-default.$description: Standard ease — smooth deceleration for most transitions.

easing-enter.$description: Enter ease — elements appearing on screen (fade in, slide in).

wide.$description: Wide desktop — BMW uses wide cinematic layouts that fill large screens.
